dataset_name: Physicochemical Properties of Protein Tertiary Structure
prompt:
Task: Estimate the RMSD score of a candidate protein structure from supplied structural descriptors.
Target: protein_structure_rmsd
Target unit: source RMSD units
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing or an invalid measurement replaced with missing.
Field definitions and context: F1: total surface area; F2: nonpolar exposed area; F3/F4: source exposed-area descriptors; F5: mass-weighted exposed area; F6: deviation from standard exposed area; F7: Euclidean-distance descriptor; F8: secondary-structure penalty; F9: spatial-distribution constraints. Original descriptor scales are retained.
Input JSON: {"F1":13558.3,"F2":4305.35,"F3":0.31754,"F4":162.173,"F5":1872790.507,"F6":215.359,"F7":4287.87,"F8":102,"F9":27.0302}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
